acceptance: Open/in-progress task views, closed/verified filters and responsive list/board workspace.
Per-account IndexedDB restores project/view state and fetches only missing changed blobs.
Task creation/status/details/priority edits append valid causally-linked DIP events committed to selected GitHub branch.
Writes check user repository permission, expected snapshot and non-force branch update; conflicting commits remain visible for retry.
Existing data and secrets stay protected; logout purges local account cache.
Deploy and validate real read/cache behavior; request concrete app write permission approval at final step.
payload.description: User explicitly requested GitHub-persisted task editing. Add create/update actions recording immutable DIP events via non-forced Git commits with concurrency checking. CRM workspace and account-scoped incremental IndexedDB cache. Final app Contents write permission and installation approval required for real write validation.
